contract: Optional RSVP playback reads the existing canonical Knowledge item body and persists only per-item canonical word offset, WPM, chunk size and bookmark state. Playback is browser-local, content revision guards prevent stale writes, and ordinary reading plus annotations remain authoritative.
acceptance: Open an actual active canonical Knowledge item through guarded HTTP or native tools; refuse missing, archived or textless items without creating a second content library.
Tokenize Unicode text with source offsets, attach standalone opening and closing punctuation to neighboring words, and apply sentence, clause, long-token and chunk-aware timing.
Persist canonical word offset independently of one- or two-word presentation so changing chunk size never jumps or reinterprets position.
Pause and resume browser playback, bound WPM to 100 through 1000, bound chunks to one or two words, and persist position plus settings across service reconstruction.
Bookmark an exact word offset, move elsewhere, restore that bookmark after reload, and reject stale content revisions before overwriting state.
When canonical content changes, clamp prior offsets and bookmarks to the current token range, disclose reconciliation once, and require the new revision for subsequent writes.
Return from RSVP to the existing ordinary reader with current annotation highlights intact; actual HTTP and DOM consumers exercise the real store and state endpoints.
remaining_limits: Playback timers run only while the reader is mounted; durable state records position and settings, not a claim that playback continued while the console was closed.
Content-change reconciliation safely clamps offsets but does not semantically relocate edited passages; the content_changed disclosure tells the reader to confirm the new position.
One explicit bookmark per canonical item is in scope; annotation/highlight collections remain the existing mechanism for multiple anchored passages.
RSVP is embedded in the existing Knowledge reading surface and needs no duplicate navigation destination.

verification.note: One serialized promise queue orders position writes; click-time snapshots and state generations prevent delayed saves or responses from replacing newer pause, bookmark or restore state.
